notes: Contact planes/radial boundaries from actual STEP; annuli are interrupted by holes/scallops, not guaranteed full rings.
Positive upstream-axis slab gap proves only adjacent OEM housings stay disjoint for the single relative joint rotation; not brackets, hardware, nonadjacent housings or cables.
6mm annulus, cap heads and8mm collar are probes, not selected load-bearing parts.
No output screw length frozen because complete thread-start evidence is missing.
Rear contact approach side is -localZ; plane-axis orientation and bracket approach side are separated explicitly.
RH20 rear end is -94.9mm relative output plane due2.5mm boss height, not -95.4mm from a generic2mm-boss envelope.
J1 5mm plate alternative leaves0.9317mm nominal cap-head clearance only; no structural/tolerance release.
Original L3 and L5 beams have true CAD interference and incomplete end connections; cannot manufacture the old beams as-is.

method.contact: Outer coaxial annular planar faces at independently identified datum; split faces retained; inner coplanar faces excluded.
method.transform: T_home_joint @ inverse(T_vendor_world_joint); proper rigid transform only.
method.slab_gap: min(z downstream in upstream joint frame) - max(z upstream OEM); positive gap remains under common upstream transforms and relative rotation about localZ.
method.collision: Solid-pair Boolean common with AABB pruning, threshold1e-4mm3. Sum may double count overlapping source solids.
method.minimum_clearance: Solid-pair exact BREP distance with cached AABB lower-bound pruning; zero when intersecting.
method.phase_scope: current source assembly phase only; output caps fixed relative attached downstream housing; no encoder zero inference.
